historicalAudit.limitation: Only unambiguous detail-query total claims were automatically compared. This is not evidence that all historical prose is correct.

protection: Count returned rows and missing fields on server without deduplicating or dropping nulls
Separate returned row counts from COUNT(*) aggregate values
Bind numeric references to executed call/path and expand labelled statistics on server; also allow exact quoted labelled server propositions.
Reject raw numeric claims, unknown references and contradictory all-/no-missing claims
Retry text synthesis once without rerunning query; retain actual data and report failure if still invalid
Gate statistical SSE text until validation succeeds
legacyHistory: Previously stored replies are retained as historical evidence; no historical audit records were rewritten.

programmaticAnalysisPolicy.rule: LLM understands requests, selects and invokes registered programs/skills, and explains executed results; all data statistics and analysis are calculated by programs, never by LLM arithmetic.
programmaticAnalysisPolicy.derivedMetrics: If a required statistic is absent, request another actual tool execution; report unavailability instead of calculating it in model prose.
enforcement: validate numerical answers even when there are no numerical facts
cover all structured result types and standalone MetricEvidence
do not accept cached assistant prose as calculation evidence
reject data-independent SQL constants projected as record counts/means/percentages
return species summary totals from Python rather than recomputing them in the frontend
programmaticAnalysisPolicy.regressionCase: An LLM claim of 45.21% is rejected after the fly details query; a subsequent real SQL COUNT(lc50)*100.0/COUNT(*) result may be cited.
